posts.title: The state of breakbeat in 2026
posts.description: Breaks was the music that lived in between. posts.title: Generalists vs Specialists
posts.description: Every developer I have ever hired, managed, or been, sits somewhere on a line between two people. At one end is the Generalist, who wants to know how everything works and get the job done. At the other is the Specialist, who wants to do it the right way and make it a masterpiece. posts.title: The state of UK garage in 2026
posts.description: Garage was the first dance music I ever loved that felt like it belonged to a specific place. Not a club, a city. Those skippy two-step records with the pitched-up vocals and the MCs over the top were London in a way that house wasn’t, and when the first wave died around 2003 I assumed that was it. A moment, not a genre. Then around 2019 it came back, and by 2024 everybody was calling it a revival
